title: eulophia tabularis
intro: Eulophia tabularis, commonly known as the Table orchid, is a type of orchid plant native to tropical Africa. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Eulophia tabularis include its potential to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
